description.title: Generic sample from Aspergillus oryzae RIB40

assemblyInfo.comments:
This genome assembly has been updated so
as to reflect the location and orientation of
contigs on the chromosomes. Gap lengths were
estimated using the results from Optical
Mapping (http://www.bio.nite.go.jp/dogan/project/view/AO). This Aspergillus oryzae RIB40 genome consists of a nuclear genome assembly represented by eight chromosomes (assembled from 24 entries) and three unplaced contigs (AP007156, AP007160 and AP007177) and a complete mitochondrial genome (AP007176).
